meta.title: Euro Option Pricer
meta.description: Production-grade European option pricing engine in C++ and Rust

hero.title: European Option Pricing Engine
hero.subtitle: Production-grade Black-Scholes-Merton pricing with full Greeks. Built in C++ and Rust for maximum performance.

features.title: Built for Production Trading
features.subtitle: Everything you need for real-time option pricing and delta hedging.
features.greeks_desc: Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, Rho, Dividend Rho, Vanna, Vomma, and Charm. All computed in a single pass.
features.methods_desc: Analytical closed-form, numerical finite differences, and reverse-mode automatic differentiation (Rust).
features.perf_desc: Cache-aligned structs, zero allocation in hot paths, and -O3 with native SIMD vectorization.
features.market_desc: Switchable data sources with snapshot-based consistency. Static, multi-ticker, or bring your own feed.
features.validated_desc: Put-call parity (1e-14), Hull textbook values, delta bounds, and 3-way cross-method verification.
features.safe_desc: Full input validation, NaN/Inf rejection, near-expiry edge cases handled. No undefined behavior.
